title: The Non-Resident Indians' (Keralites) Commission Act , 2015
full_text: The Non-Resident Indians' (Keralites) Commission Act , 2015 2015-ലെ പ്രവാസി ഭാരതീയര്‍ (കേരളീയര്‍) കമ്മീഷന്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20163 Act Number: 3 Enactment Date: 2016-01-27 Act Year: 2016 Short Title: The Non-Resident Indians' (Keralites) Commission Act , 2015 Hindi Title: 2015-ലെ പ്രവാസി ഭാരതീയര്‍ (കേരളീയര്‍) കമ്മീഷന്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to constitute a Commission for Non-Resident Indians hailing from Kerala with a view to protect and safeguard their interest in the State of Kerala and to recommend remedial measures for their welfare and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
